description: Backend artifacts: the Postgres SQL migration (reservations table + RLS) and the Deno Supabase Edge Function that sends German confirmation emails through Resend. Both live OUTSIDE src and are not type-checked by the build; verification is structural (reading the code) plus confirming the build is unaffected. Independent of FEAT-001; order it after FEAT-001 only to keep the branch linear. FEAT-003 depends on the table + function existing.
steps: Create supabase/migrations/0001_reservations.sql. Start with a top-of-file SQL comment documenting that the anon INSERT policy is INTENTIONAL (the public booking form inserts as the anon role) and that anon cannot SELECT others' rows.

In that migration create table public.reservations: id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), created_at timestamptz not null default now(), updated_at timestamptz not null default now(), first_name text not null, last_name text not null, email text not null, phone text not null, reservation_date date not null, reservation_time text not null, party_size int not null, seating text not null check (seating in ('Terrasse','Innen')), special_requests text, status text not null default 'Ausstehend' check (status in ('Ausstehend','Bestätigt','Platziert','Storniert','Abgeschlossen','No-Show')), table_number text.

Enable RLS: `alter table public.reservations enable row level security;`. Add policy allowing INSERT for role anon (and authenticated) with check (true). Add policies allowing SELECT, UPDATE, DELETE for role authenticated only. Do NOT grant anon SELECT.

Add an updated_at trigger: a `set_updated_at()` plpgsql function that sets new.updated_at = now(), and a `before update` trigger on reservations using it. Optionally add an index on (reservation_date, reservation_time).

Create supabase/functions/send-reservation-email/index.ts using Deno.serve. Define corsHeaders (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: '*', Access-Control-Allow-Headers for authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type, Access-Control-Allow-Methods: POST, OPTIONS). Handle OPTIONS preflight by returning new Response('ok', { headers: corsHeaders }).

In the function, read Deno.env.get('RESEND_API_KEY'), Deno.env.get('FROM_EMAIL'), Deno.env.get('RESTAURANT_EMAIL'). Parse the JSON body (first_name, last_name, email, phone, reservation_date, reservation_time, party_size, seating, special_requests). If RESEND_API_KEY is missing, return a JSON response indicating email is not configured (do not throw). POST to https://api.resend.com/emails with Authorization: Bearer <key>, sending a nicely formatted German HTML confirmation to the guest (brand 'Zum Anker', include date/time/party/seating), and — when RESTAURANT_EMAIL is set — a second notification email to the restaurant. Wrap fetch in try/catch and return JSON { ok: boolean } with corsHeaders; never crash the caller.
Keep all email copy in GERMAN and the sending structured so the admin can re-trigger confirmation on confirm later (FEAT-004 may invoke the same function).
acceptance_criteria: supabase/migrations/0001_reservations.sql exists, documents the intentional anon INSERT policy, creates the reservations table with all specified columns and the six-value status check (default 'Ausstehend'), enables RLS, grants anon INSERT only, and grants SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE to authenticated.

supabase/functions/send-reservation-email/index.ts exists, uses Deno.serve, handles OPTIONS/CORS preflight, reads RESEND_API_KEY/FROM_EMAIL/RESTAURANT_EMAIL from Deno.env, POSTs to api.resend.com/emails, sends a German HTML guest confirmation plus a restaurant notification, and never throws back to the caller.
Neither file is added to tsconfig include; `pnpm build` and `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` are unaffected and still exit 0.
verification: Run `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` and `pnpm build` — both exit 0 (these files are outside src and must not affect the build).

Read supabase/migrations/0001_reservations.sql and confirm: anon-insert comment present, six status values match the canonical set exactly, RLS enabled, anon has INSERT only, authenticated has SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE.

Read supabase/functions/send-reservation-email/index.ts and confirm OPTIONS preflight returns corsHeaders, env reads are present, the Resend fetch shape is correct, and failures are caught (no uncaught throw).
